<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>3D Car Race</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from './three.module.js';

        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Ground
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1000, 1000);
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x228B22 });
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(ground);

        // Sky
        const skyGeometry = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1000, 32, 32);
        const skyMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x87CEEB, side: THREE.BackSide });
        const sky = new THREE.Mesh(skyGeometry, skyMaterial);
        scene.add(sky);

        // Track and Finish Line
        const trackGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 200);
        const trackMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x808080 });
        const track = new THREE.Mesh(trackGeometry, trackMaterial);
        track.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        track.position.z = -50;
        scene.add(track);

        const finishLineGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(10, 1);
        const finishLineMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFFFF00 });
        const finishLine = new THREE.Mesh(finishLineGeometry, finishLineMaterial);
        finishLine.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        finishLine.position.z = -100;
        scene.add(finishLine);

        // Cars
        const carGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 4);
        const redCarMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xFF0000 });
        const blueCarMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x0000FF });
        const redCar = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, redCarMaterial);
        const blueCar = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, blueCarMaterial);
        redCar.position.set(-2, 0.5, 0);
        blueCar.position.set(2, 0.5, 0);
        scene.add(redCar);
        scene.add(blueCar);

        // Camera Position
        camera.position.z = 10;
        camera.position.y = 5;

        let blueCarSpeed = 0.4;
        let redCarSpeed = 0.3;
        let redCarAccelerating = false;
        let redCarWins = false;

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            if (!redCarWins) {
                blueCar.position.z -= blueCarSpeed;
                if (!redCarAccelerating && blueCar.position.z < -30) {
                    redCarAccelerating = true;
                }
                if (redCarAccelerating) {
                    redCarSpeed += 0.01;
                }
                redCar.position.z -= redCarSpeed;

                if (redCar.position.z <= finishLine.position.z) {
                    redCarWins = true;
                }
            } else {
                // Reset positions after the red car crosses the finish line
                redCar.position.set(-2, 0.5, 0);
                blueCar.position.set(2, 0.5, 0);
                redCarSpeed = 0.3;
                blueCarSpeed = 0.4;
                redCarAccelerating = false;
                redCarWins = false;
            }

            // Camera follows the cars
            camera.position.z = Math.min(redCar.position.z, blueCar.position.z) - 10;
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        animate();

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
